verdict.rationale: Marqeta's webhooks provide event-driven, background notifications and its gateway JIT funding lets a developer's system autonomously approve/deny funding requests, and the MCP server lets AI agents query data and take actions (issue cards, set spend controls) via natural language — together these enable background/autonomous workflows built on top of the platform. However there's no evidence of a built-in scheduler, workflow/automation builder, or persistent autonomous agent runtime — it's infrastructure (APIs/webhooks/MCP) that a developer must wire up themselves. Missing for 10: native automation/orchestration engine, evidence of agents running unattended over time, and independent confirmation of autonomous background operation.
